description: Converts BibTeX or CSL-JSON entries into tp-biblio or standard LaTeX bibliography source code.

attributes.name: src
attributes.description: URL of a bibliography file; takes priority over the inline script.

methods.name: getCode(): string
methods.description: Return the latest successfully generated source, or an empty string while loading or after an error.

methods.name: refresh(): Promise<void>
methods.description: Reload the source and update the code. Await this before calling getCode for a remote source. Fetch/parse errors are displayed and emitted through tp-bibtex-error.

events.name: tp-bibtex-error
events.description: Emitted when fetching or parsing fails, with an error message.

events.name: tp-bibtex-load
events.description: Emitted after conversion with the generated code and format.
events.detail: { code: string; in: string; out: string }

dependencies.name: tp-base
dependencies.summary: Shared base class for tp-* components.

credits.name: tp-latex
credits.summary: LaTeX.js conversion and patched TikZJax assets.

userHelp.introduction: The custom `<tp-bibtex>` element converts BibTeX or CSL-JSON entries into tp-biblio or standard LaTeX bibliography source code.
userHelp.interactions:
#### Mouse interactions

| Action | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Select generated text | Select code in the embedded readonly editor. Its copy and save commands belong to tp-code-editor. |

#### Keyboard interactions

| Key | Result |
| --- | --- |
| <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>?</kbd> | Open contextual help for the component under the pointer or with focus; Shift may be needed for ?. |
| <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>Alt</kbd>+<kbd>?</kbd> | Open the component viewer. |

There are no component-specific buttons or editing shortcuts. The embedded editor provides its own controls and help.
